t_advice_summary_textbox.text: brown, purple, pink and yellow gnomes tend to yield the best results

vb_textbox.text: i found that the red mushrooms would yield the highest results most frequently, though as soon as i noticed one color i picked going down in amount, i would switch to the opposite color. there was no set rule to how often the switch would occur. start out picking purple, pink, red, and brown but switch to their opposites (blue, green, yellow, and orange) when you notice they start yielding lower results.
